title: From the Rock Floor to the Cloud: A Systematic Survey of State-of-the-Art NLP in Battery Life Cycle
abstract: arXiv:2510.27369v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work presents a systematic review of the application of natural language processing (NLP) along the entire battery life cycle, instead of the review of one stage or method, and introduces a novel conceptual technical language processing (TLP) framework for the European Union (EU)'s proposed digital battery passport (DBP) and other general battery predictions, as the main objective. It follows the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) method and employs three reputable databases or search engines, including Google Scholar, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers Xplore (IEEE Xplore), and Scopus, searched in October, 2025. translated_title: 从岩层到云端：电池全生命周期中最先进自然语言处理技术的系统性综述
translated_abstract: 本工作对自然语言处理（NLP）在电池全生命周期中的应用进行了系统性综述，而非仅针对某一阶段或方法的综述，并以此为主要目标，为欧盟（EU）提议的数字电池护照（DBP）以及其他通用电池预测引入了一种新颖的概念性技术语言处理（TLP）框架。该综述遵循系统综述与荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）方法，采用三个权威数据库或搜索引擎进行检索，包括Google Scholar、电气电子工程师学会Xplore（IEEE Xplore）和Scopus，检索时间为2025年10月。检索标准为“文本”、“语言处理”和“电池”，排除标准为不相关的论文以及2017年之前发表的论文；该标准适用于所有数据库，但IEEE Xplore除外，因其检索结果较少。因此，……
tldr: 该论文系统综述了自然语言处理在电池全生命周期各阶段的应用，并提出了一种面向欧盟数字电池护照（DBP）的新型技术语言处理（TLP）概念框架。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys NLP applications across the entire battery life cycle and proposes a novel Technical Language Processing (TLP) conceptual framework for the EU's proposed digital battery passport (DBP).
